text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Use two dials as a map: quadru-pole across, dipole up. With the knob low, the state circles in one whirlpool, and stays. A mirror twin circles the mirror whirlpool: dipole down. Each start is trapped. The dipole never changes sign.
